topic: Data versioning and model transition discussion
summary_markdown:
A meeting was proposed to discuss data versioning issues and the smooth transition of all calculations to the internal system. The time for this meeting was adjusted from 5 PM to 4 PM, as multiple participants confirmed availability at that earlier time.

The discussion topic centered on model versions rather than simply adding a version column to every table. It was noted that previous data aggregation issues were resolved, and the focus would be on reviewing complex aspects of file/model versions.
decisions: The meeting time for discussing data versioning will be 4 PM.
